verses.original: וְהַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַיְכַסֻּ֙הוּ֙ בַּבְּגָדִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִחַ֖ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ zā·qên bā bay·yā·mîm way·ḵas·su·hū bab·bə·ḡā·ḏîm wə·lō yi·ḥam lōw
verses.literal: Now King David was old and well along in years and though they covered him with blankets he could not keep warm
verses.literalPt: SENDO, pois, o rei Davi já velho, e entrado em dias, cobriam-no de roupas, porém não se aquecia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמְרוּ ל֣וֹ עֲבָדָ֗יו יְבַקְשׁ֞וּ לַאדֹנִ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה בְתוּלָ֔ה וְעָֽמְדָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּתְהִי־ ל֖וֹ סֹכֶ֑נֶת וְשָׁכְבָ֣ה בְחֵיקֶ֔ךָ וְחַ֖ם לַאדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lōw ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw yə·ḇaq·šū la·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ na·‘ă·rāh ḇə·ṯū·lāh wə·‘ā·mə·ḏāh lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ ū·ṯə·hî- lōw sō·ḵe·neṯ wə·šā·ḵə·ḇāh ḇə·ḥê·qe·ḵā wə·ḥam la·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: So his servants said to him Let us search for a young virgin for our lord the king to attend to him and care for him and lie by his side to keep him . . . warm
verses.literalPt: Então disseram-lhe os seus servos: Busquem para o rei meu senhor uma moça virgem, que esteja perante o rei, e tenha cuidado dele; e durma no seu seio, para que o rei meu senhor se aqueça.

verses.original: וַיְבַקְשׁוּ֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה יָפָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּמְצְא֗וּ אֶת־ אֲבִישַׁג֙ הַשּׁ֣וּנַמִּ֔ית וַיָּבִ֥אוּ אֹתָ֖הּ לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇaq·šū na·‘ă·rāh yā·p̄āh bə·ḵōl gə·ḇūl yiś·rā·’êl way·yim·ṣə·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·šaḡ haš·šū·nam·mîṯ way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’ō·ṯāh lam·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then they searched throughout . . . Israel for a beautiful girl and they found Abishag the Shunammite and brought her to the king
verses.literalPt: E buscaram por todos os termos de Israel uma moça formosa, e acharam a Abisague, sunamita; e a trouxeram ao rei.

verses.original: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ה יָפָ֣ה עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד וַתְּהִ֨י לַמֶּ֤לֶךְ סֹכֶ֙נֶת֙ וַתְּשָׁ֣רְתֵ֔הוּ וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א יְדָעָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·na·‘ă·rāh yā·p̄āh ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ wat·tə·hî lam·me·leḵ sō·ḵe·neṯ wat·tə·šā·rə·ṯê·hū wə·ham·me·leḵ lō yə·ḏā·‘āh
verses.literal: The girl was unsurpassed . . . in beauty she cared for the king and served him but he had no relations with her
verses.literalPt: E era a moça sobremaneira formosa; e tinha cuidado do rei, e o servia; porém o rei não a conheceu.

verses.original: וַאֲדֹנִיָּ֧ה בֶן־ חַגִּ֛ית מִתְנַשֵּׂ֥א לֵאמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י אֶמְלֹ֑ךְ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ ל֗וֹ רֶ֚כֶב וּפָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ רָצִ֥ים לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḏō·nî·yāh ḇen- ḥag·gîṯ miṯ·naś·śê lê·mōr ’ă·nî ’em·lōḵ way·ya·‘aś lōw re·ḵeḇ ū·p̄ā·rā·šîm wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’îš rā·ṣîm lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: At that time Adonijah David’s son by Haggith began to exalt himself saying I will be king And he acquired . . . chariots and horsemen and fifty men to run ahead of him
verses.literalPt: Então Adonias, filho de Hagite, se levantou, dizendo: Eu reinarei. E preparou carros, e cavaleiros, e cinqüenta homens, que corressem adiante dele.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ עֲצָב֨וֹ אָבִ֤יו מִיָּמָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַדּ֖וּעַ כָּ֣כָה עָשִׂ֑יתָ וְגַם־ ה֤וּא טֽוֹב־ תֹּ֙אַר֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְאֹת֥וֹ יָלְדָ֖ה אַחֲרֵ֥י אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ‘ă·ṣā·ḇōw ’ā·ḇîw mî·yā·māw lê·mōr mad·dū·a‘ kā·ḵāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā wə·ḡam- hū ṭō·wḇ- tō·’ar mə·’ōḏ wə·’ō·ṯōw yā·lə·ḏāh ’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: His father had never . . . once reprimanded him by saying Why do you act this way Adonijah was also very handsome . . . born next after Absalom
verses.literalPt: E nunca seu pai o tinha contrariado, dizendo: Por que fizeste assim? E era ele também muito formoso de parecer; e Hagite o tivera depois de Absalão.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ דְבָרָ֔יו עִ֚ם יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֔ה וְעִ֖ם אֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַֽיַּעְזְר֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū ḏə·ḇā·rāw ‘im yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh wə·‘im ’eḇ·yā·ṯār hak·kō·hên way·ya‘·zə·rū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḏō·nî·yāh
verses.literal: So Adonijah conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest who supported . . . him
verses.literalPt: E tinha entendimento com Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e com Abiatar o sacerdote; os quais o ajudavam, seguindo a Adonias.

verses.original: וְצָד֣וֹק הַ֠כֹּהֵן וּבְנָיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע וְנָתָ֤ן הַנָּבִיא֙ וְשִׁמְעִ֣י וְרֵעִ֔י וְהַגִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑ד לֹ֥א הָי֖וּ עִם־ אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî wə·šim·‘î wə·rê·‘î wə·hag·gib·bō·w·rîm ’ă·šer lə·ḏā·wiḏ lō hā·yū ‘im- ’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū
verses.literal: But Zadok the priest Benaiah son of Jehoiada Nathan the prophet Shimei Rei and David’s mighty men would not . . . join Adonijah
verses.literalPt: Porém Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Benaia, filho de Joiada, e Natã, o profeta, e Simei, e Rei, e os poderosos que Davi tinha, não estavam com Adonias.

verses.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֣ח אֲדֹנִיָּ֗הוּ צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ וּמְרִ֔יא עִ֚ם אֶ֣בֶן הַזֹּחֶ֔לֶת אֲשֶׁר־ אֵ֖צֶל עֵ֣ין רֹגֵ֑ל וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶת־ כָּל־ אֶחָיו֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְכָל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עַבְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·baḥ ’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār ū·mə·rî ‘im ’e·ḇen haz·zō·ḥe·leṯ ’ă·šer- ’ê·ṣel ‘ên rō·ḡêl way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- kāl- ’e·ḥāw bə·nê ham·me·leḵ ū·lə·ḵāl- ’an·šê yə·hū·ḏāh ‘aḇ·ḏê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: And Adonijah sacrificed sheep oxen and fattened calves near the stone of Zoheleth which is next to En-rogel He invited all his royal brothers . . . and all the men of Judah who were servants of the king
verses.literalPt: E matou Adonias ovelhas, e vacas, e animais cevados, junto à pedra de Zoelete, que está perto da fonte de Rogel; e convidou a todos os seus irmãos, os filhos do rei, e a todos os homens de Judá, servos do rei.

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ נָתָן֩ הַנָּבִ֨יא וּבְנָיָ֜הוּ וְאֶת־ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וְאֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה אָחִ֖יו לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū wə·’eṯ- hag·gib·bō·w·rîm wə·’eṯ- šə·lō·mōh ’ā·ḥîw lō qā·rā
verses.literal: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet Benaiah the mighty men or his brother Solomon
verses.literalPt: Porém a Natã, o profeta, e a Benaia, e aos poderosos, e a Salomão, seu irmão, não convidou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר נָתָ֗ן אֶל־ בַּת־ שֶׁ֤בַע אֵם־ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲל֣וֹא שָׁמַ֔עַתְּ כִּ֥י מָלַ֖ךְ אֲדֹנִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן־ חַגִּ֑ית וַאֲדֹנֵ֥ינוּ דָוִ֖ד לֹ֥א יָדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nā·ṯān ’el- baṯ- še·ḇa‘ ’êm- šə·lō·mōh lê·mōr hă·lō·w šā·ma·‘at kî mā·laḵ ’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū ḇen- ḥag·gîṯ wa·’ă·ḏō·nê·nū ḏā·wiḏ lō yā·ḏā‘
verses.literal: Then Nathan said to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon Have you not heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has become king and our lord David does not know it
verses.literalPt: Então falou Natã a Bate-Seba, mãe de Salomão, dizendo: Não ouviste que Adonias, filho de Hagite, reina? E que nosso senhor Davi não o sabe?

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה לְכִ֛י אִיעָצֵ֥ךְ נָ֖א עֵצָ֑ה וּמַלְּטִי֙ אֶת־ נַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ וְאֶת־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ בְּנֵ֖ךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lə·ḵî ’î·‘ā·ṣêḵ nā ‘ê·ṣāh ū·mal·lə·ṭî ’eṯ- nap̄·šêḵ wə·’eṯ- ne·p̄eš bə·nêḵ šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: Now please come and let me advise you Save your own life and the life of your son Solomon
verses.literalPt: Vem, pois, agora, e deixa-me dar-te um conselho, para que salves a tua vida, e a de Salomão teu filho.

verses.original: לְכִ֞י וּבֹ֣אִי׀ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וְאָמַ֤רְתְּ אֵלָיו֙ הֲלֹֽא־ אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ נִשְׁבַּ֤עְתָּ לַאֲמָֽתְךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּֽי־ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בְנֵךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֔י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֣ב עַל־ כִּסְאִ֑י וּמַדּ֖וּעַ מָלַ֥ךְ אֲדֹנִיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵî ū·ḇō·’î ’el- ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ wə·’ā·mart ’ê·lāw hă·lō- ’at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ niš·ba‘·tā la·’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā lê·mōr kî- šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nêḵ yim·lōḵ ’a·ḥă·ray wə·hū yê·šêḇ ‘al- kis·’î ū·mad·dū·a‘ mā·laḵ ʾă·ḏō·ni·yå̄·hū
verses.literal: Go at once to King David and say My lord the king did you not swear to your maidservant Surely your son Solomon will reign after me and he will sit on my throne Why then has Adonijah become king
verses.literalPt: Vai, e chega ao rei Davi, e dize-lhe: Não juraste tu, rei senhor meu, à tua serva, dizendo: Certamente teu filho Salomão reinará depois de mim, e ele se assentará no meu trono? Por que, pois, reina Adonias?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֗ה עוֹדָ֛ךְ מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת שָׁ֖ם עִם־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲנִי֙ אָב֣וֹא אַחֲרַ֔יִךְ וּמִלֵּאתִ֖י אֶת־ דְּבָרָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘ō·w·ḏāḵ mə·ḏab·be·reṯ šām ‘im- ham·me·leḵ wa·’ă·nî ’ā·ḇō·w ’a·ḥă·ra·yiḵ ū·mil·lê·ṯî ’eṯ- də·ḇā·rā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Then while you are still there speaking with the king I will come in after you and confirm your words
verses.literalPt: Eis que, estando tu ainda aí falando com o rei, eu também entrarei depois de ti, e confirmarei as tuas palavras.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֨א בַת־ שֶׁ֤בֶע אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַחַ֔דְרָה וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ זָקֵ֣ן מְאֹ֑ד וַֽאֲבִישַׁג֙ הַשּׁ֣וּנַמִּ֔ית מְשָׁרַ֖ת אֶת־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō ḇaṯ- še·ḇe‘ ’el- ham·me·leḵ ha·ḥaḏ·rāh wə·ham·me·leḵ zā·qên mə·’ōḏ wa·’ă·ḇî·šaḡ haš·šū·nam·mîṯ mə·šā·raṯ ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: So Bathsheba went to see the king in his bedroom Since the king was very old Abishag the Shunammite was serving him
verses.literalPt: E foi Bate-Seba ao rei na sua câmara; e o rei era muito velho; e Abisague, a sunamita, servia ao rei.

verses.original: וַתִּקֹּ֣ד בַּת־ שֶׁ֔בַע וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מַה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qōḏ baṯ- še·ḇa‘ wat·tiš·ta·ḥū lam·me·leḵ way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ mah- lāḵ
verses.literal: And Bathsheba bowed down in homage to the king who asked What is your desire
verses.literalPt: E Bate-Seba inclinou a cabeça, e se prostrou perante o rei; e disse o rei: Que tens?

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אֲדֹנִי֙ אַתָּ֨ה נִשְׁבַּ֜עְתָּ בַּֽיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לַֽאֲמָתֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֵ֖ךְ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרָ֑י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְאִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lōw ’ă·ḏō·nî ’at·tāh niš·ba‘·tā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā la·’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā kî- šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nêḵ yim·lōḵ ’a·ḥă·rāy wə·hū yê·šêḇ ‘al- kis·’î
verses.literal: My lord she replied you yourself swore to your maidservant by the LORD your God Surely your son Solomon will reign after me and he will sit on my throne
verses.literalPt: E ela lhe disse: Senhor meu, tu juraste à tua serva pelo SENHOR teu Deus, dizendo: Salomão, teu filho, reinará depois de mim, e ele se assentará no meu trono.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֥ה אֲדֹנִיָּ֖ה מָלָ֑ךְ וְעַתָּ֛ה אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nî·yāh mā·lāḵ wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ lō yā·ḏā·‘ə·tā
verses.literal: But now behold Adonijah has become king and you my lord the king do not know it
verses.literalPt: E agora eis que Adonias reina; e tu, ó rei meu senhor, não o sabes.

verses.original: וַ֠יִּזְבַּח שׁ֥וֹר וּֽמְרִיא־ וְצֹאן֮ לָרֹב֒ וַיִּקְרָא֙ לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּלְאֶבְיָתָר֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וּלְיֹאָ֖ב שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֑א וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·baḥ šō·wr ū·mə·rî- wə·ṣōn lā·rōḇ way·yiq·rā lə·ḵāl bə·nê ham·me·leḵ ū·lə·’eḇ·yā·ṯār hak·kō·hên ū·lə·yō·’āḇ śar haṣ·ṣā·ḇā wə·liš·lō·mōh ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lō qā·rā
verses.literal: And he has sacrificed an abundance of oxen fattened calves and sheep and has invited all the other sons of the king as well as Abiathar the priest and Joab the commander of the army But he has not invited your servant Solomon
verses.literalPt: E matou vacas, e animais cevados, e ovelhas em abundância, e convidou a todos os filhos do rei, e a Abiatar, o sacerdote, e a Joabe, capitão do exército, mas a teu servo Salomão não convidou.

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עֵינֵ֥י כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלֶ֑יךָ לְהַגִּ֣יד לָהֶ֔ם מִ֗י יֵשֵׁ֛ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ‘ê·nê ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·le·ḵā lə·hag·gîḏ lā·hem mî yê·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê ’ă·ḏō·nî- ham·me·leḵ ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: And as for you my lord the king the eyes of all Israel are upon you to tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him
verses.literalPt: Porém, ó rei meu senhor, os olhos de todo o Israel estão sobre ti, para que lhe declares quem se assentará sobre o trono do rei meu senhor, depois dele.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֕ה כִּשְׁכַ֥ב אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֑יו וְהָיִ֗יתִי אֲנִ֛י וּבְנִ֥י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חַטָּאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kiš·ḵaḇ ’ă·ḏō·nî- ham·me·leḵ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw wə·hā·yî·ṯî ’ă·nî ū·ḇə·nî šə·lō·mōh ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm
verses.literal: Otherwise, when my lord the king rests with his fathers . . . I and my son Solomon will be counted as criminals
verses.literalPt: De outro modo sucederá que, quando o rei meu senhor dormir com seus pais, eu e Salomão meu filho seremos os culpados.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֛ה עוֹדֶ֥נָּה מְדַבֶּ֖רֶת עִם־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְנָתָ֥ן הַנָּבִ֖יא בָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ‘ō·w·ḏen·nāh mə·ḏab·be·reṯ ‘im- ham·me·leḵ wə·nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî bā
verses.literal: And just then while Bathsheba was still speaking with the king Nathan the prophet arrived
verses.literalPt: E, estando ela ainda falando com o rei, eis que entra o profeta Natã.

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֖ה נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֑יא וַיָּבֹא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל־ אַפָּ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gî·ḏū lam·me·leḵ lê·mōr hin·nêh nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî way·yā·ḇō lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ way·yiš·ta·ḥū lam·me·leḵ ‘al- ’ap·pāw ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: So the king was told . . . Nathan the prophet is here And Nathan went in and bowed facedown . . . . . . before the king
verses.literalPt: E o fizeram saber ao rei, dizendo: Eis aí está o profeta Natã. E entrou à presença do rei, e prostrou-se diante dele com o rosto em terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ נָתָן֒ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֔רְתָּ אֲדֹנִיָּ֖הוּ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרָ֑י וְה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְאִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nā·ṯān ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ ’at·tāh ’ā·mar·tā ’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū yim·lōḵ ’a·ḥă·rāy wə·hū yê·šêḇ ‘al- kis·’î
verses.literal: My lord the king said Nathan did you say Adonijah will reign after me and he will sit on my throne
verses.literalPt: E disse Natã: Ó rei meu senhor, disseste tu: Adonias reinará depois de mim, e ele se assentará sobre o meu trono?

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ יָרַ֣ד הַיּ֗וֹם וַ֠יִּזְבַּח שׁ֥וֹר וּֽמְרִיא־ וְצֹאן֮ לָרֹב֒ וַיִּקְרָא֩ לְכָל־ בְּנֵ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וּלְשָׂרֵ֤י הַצָּבָא֙ וּלְאֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנָּ֛ם אֹכְלִ֥ים וְשֹׁתִ֖ים לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yā·raḏ hay·yō·wm way·yiz·baḥ šō·wr ū·mə·rî- wə·ṣōn lā·rōḇ way·yiq·rā lə·ḵāl bə·nê ham·me·leḵ ū·lə·śā·rê haṣ·ṣā·ḇā ū·lə·’eḇ·yā·ṯār hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nām ’ō·ḵə·lîm wə·šō·ṯîm lə·p̄ā·nāw way·yō·mə·rū yə·ḥî ham·me·leḵ ’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū
verses.literal: For today he has gone down and sacrificed an abundance of oxen fattened calves and sheep and has invited all the sons of the king the commanders of the army and Abiathar the priest And behold they are eating and drinking before him saying Long live King Adonijah
verses.literalPt: Porque hoje desceu, e matou vacas, e animais cevados, e ovelhas em abundância, e convidou a todos os filhos do rei e aos capitães do exército, e a Abiatar, o sacerdote, e eis que estão comendo e bebendo perante ele; e dizem: Viva o rei Adonias.

verses.original: וְלִ֣י אֲנִֽי־ עַ֠בְדֶּךָ וּלְצָדֹ֨ק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלִבְנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א קָרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lî ’ă·nî- ‘aḇ·de·ḵā ū·lə·ṣā·ḏōq hak·kō·hên wə·liḇ·nā·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·liš·lō·mōh ‘aḇ·də·ḵā lō qā·rā
verses.literal: But me your servant he has not invited nor Zadok the priest nor Benaiah son of Jehoiada nor your servant Solomon
verses.literalPt: Porém a mim, sendo eu teu servo, e a Zadoque, o sacerdote, e a Benaia, filho de Joiada, e a Salomão, teu servo, não convidou.

verses.original: אִ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ נִהְיָ֖ה הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְלֹ֤א הוֹדַ֙עְתָּ֙ אֶֽת־ עַבְדֶּיךָ מִ֗י יֵשֵׁ֛ב עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im mê·’êṯ ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ nih·yāh had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh wə·lō hō·w·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- ʿaḇ·dɛ·ḵå̄ mî yê·šêḇ ‘al- kis·sê ’ă·ḏō·nî- ham·me·leḵ ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: Has . . . my lord the king let this happen . . . without informing your servant who should sit on the throne after my lord the king
verses.literalPt: Foi feito isto da parte do rei meu senhor? E não fizeste saber a teu servo quem se assentaria no trono do rei meu senhor depois dele?

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר קִרְאוּ־ לִ֖י לְבַת־ שָׁ֑בַע וַתָּבֹא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer qir·’ū- lî lə·ḇaṯ- šā·ḇa‘ wat·tā·ḇō lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ wat·ta·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then King David said Call in Bathsheba for me So she came into the king’s presence and stood before him . . .
verses.literalPt: E respondeu o rei Davi, e disse: Chamai-me a Bate-Seba. E ela entrou à presença do rei; e ficou em pé diante do rei.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֥ע הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר חַי־ יְהוָ֕ה אֲשֶׁר־ פָּדָ֥ה אֶת־ נַפְשִׁ֖י מִכָּל־ צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mar ḥay- Yah·weh ’ă·šer- pā·ḏāh ’eṯ- nap̄·šî mik·kāl ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: And the king swore an oath saying As surely as the LORD lives who has redeemed my life from all distress
verses.literalPt: Então jurou o rei e disse: Vive o SENHOR, o qual remiu a minha alma de toda a angústia,

verses.original: כִּ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי לָ֜ךְ בַּיהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּֽי־ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בְנֵךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֔י וְה֛וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְאִ֖י תַּחְתָּ֑י כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî lāḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr kî- šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nêḵ yim·lōḵ ’a·ḥă·ray wə·hū yê·šêḇ ‘al- kis·’î taḥ·tāy kî kên ’e·‘ĕ·śeh hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: I will carry out this very day exactly what I swore to you by the LORD the God of Israel . . . Surely your son Solomon will reign after me and he will sit on my throne in my place
verses.literalPt: Que, como te jurei pelo SENHOR Deus de Israel, dizendo: Certamente teu filho Salomão reinará depois de mim, e ele se assentará no meu trono, em meu lugar, assim o farei no dia de hoje.

verses.original: וַתִּקֹּ֨ד בַּת־ שֶׁ֤בַע אַפַּ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וַתִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַתֹּ֕אמֶר יְחִ֗י אֲדֹנִ֛י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד לְעֹלָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qōḏ baṯ- še·ḇa‘ ’ap·pa·yim ’e·reṣ wat·tiš·ta·ḥū lam·me·leḵ wat·tō·mer yə·ḥî ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ lə·‘ō·lām
verses.literal: Bathsheba bowed facedown . . . in homage to the king and said May my lord King David live forever
verses.literalPt: Então Bate-Seba se inclinou com o rosto em terra e se prostrou diante do rei, e disse: Viva o rei Davi meu senhor para sempre.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד קִרְאוּ־ לִ֞י לְצָד֤וֹק הַכֹּהֵן֙ וּלְנָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֔יא וְלִבְנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ qir·’ū- lî lə·ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên ū·lə·nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî wə·liḇ·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ way·yā·ḇō·’ū lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then King David said Call in for me Zadok the priest Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada So they came before the king
verses.literalPt: E disse o rei Davi: Chamai-me a Zadoque, o sacerdote, e a Natã, o profeta, e a Benaia, filho de Joiada. E eles entraram à presença do rei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לָהֶ֗ם קְח֤וּ עִמָּכֶם֙ אֶת־ עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִרְכַּבְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔י עַל־ הַפִּרְדָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ לִ֑י וְהוֹרַדְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־ גִּחֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ lā·hem qə·ḥū ‘im·mā·ḵem ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem wə·hir·kaḇ·tem ’eṯ- šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nî ‘al- hap·pir·dāh ’ă·šer- lî wə·hō·w·raḏ·tem ’ō·ṯōw ’el- gi·ḥō·wn
verses.literal: Take my servants . . . with you said the king Set my son Solomon on my own mule and take him down to Gihon
verses.literalPt: E o rei lhes disse: Tomai convosco os servos de vosso senhor, e fazei subir a meu filho Salomão na mula que é minha; e levai-o a Giom.

verses.original: וּמָשַׁ֣ח אֹת֣וֹ שָׁ֠ם צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְנָתָ֧ן הַנָּבִ֛יא לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּתְקַעְתֶּם֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw šām ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên wə·nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ū·ṯə·qa‘·tem baš·šō·w·p̄ār wa·’ă·mar·tem yə·ḥî ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: There Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet are to anoint him king over Israel You are to blow the ram’s horn and declare Long live King Solomon
verses.literalPt: E Zadoque, o sacerdote, com Natã, o profeta, ali o ungirão rei sobre Israel; então tocareis a trombeta, e direis: Viva o rei Salomão!

verses.original: וַעֲלִיתֶ֣ם אַחֲרָ֗יו וּבָא֙ וְיָשַׁ֣ב עַל־ כִּסְאִ֔י וְה֥וּא יִמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑י וְאֹת֤וֹ צִוִּ֙יתִי֙ לִֽהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְעַל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·lî·ṯem ’a·ḥă·rāw ū·ḇā wə·yā·šaḇ ‘al- kis·’î wə·hū yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāy wə·’ō·ṯōw ṣiw·wî·ṯî lih·yō·wṯ nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Then you shall go up with him and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place For I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah
verses.literalPt: Então subireis após ele, e virá e se assentará no meu trono, e ele reinará em meu lugar; porque tenho ordenado que ele seja guia sobre Israel e sobre Judá.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ יְהֽוֹיָדָ֛ע אֶת־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ אָמֵ֑ן כֵּ֚ן יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י אֲדֹנִ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an bə·nā·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer ’ā·mên kên yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Amen replied Benaiah son of Jehoiada May the LORD the God of my lord the king so . . . declare it
verses.literalPt: Então Benaia, filho de Joiada, respondeu ao rei, e disse: Amém; assim o diga o SENHOR Deus do rei meu senhor.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִם־ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כֵּ֖ן יְהִי עִם־ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וִֽיגַדֵּל֙ אֶת־ כִּסְא֔וֹ מִ֨כִּסֵּ֔א אֲדֹנִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer hā·yāh Yah·weh ‘im- ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ kên yə·hī ‘im- šə·lō·mōh wî·ḡad·dêl ’eṯ- kis·’ōw mik·kis·sê ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Just as the LORD was with my lord the king so may He be with Solomon and make his throne even greater than that of my lord King David
verses.literalPt: Como o SENHOR foi com o rei meu senhor, assim o seja com Salomão, e faça que o seu trono seja maior do que o trono do rei Davi meu senhor.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣רֶד צָד֣וֹק הַ֠כֹּהֵן וְנָתָ֨ן הַנָּבִ֜יא וּבְנָיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֗ע וְהַכְּרֵתִי֙ וְהַפְּלֵתִ֔י וַיַּרְכִּ֙בוּ֙ אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַל־ פִּרְדַּ֖ת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד וַיֹּלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־ גִּחֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên wə·nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·hak·kə·rê·ṯî wə·hap·pə·lê·ṯî way·yar·ki·ḇū ’eṯ- šə·lō·mōh ‘al- pir·daṯ ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ way·yō·li·ḵū ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- gi·ḥō·wn
verses.literal: Then Zadok the priest Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada along with the Cherethites and Pelethites went down and set Solomon on King David’s mule and they escorted him to Gihon
verses.literalPt: Então desceu Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Natã, o profeta, e Benaia, filho de Joiada, e os quereteus, e os peleteus, e fizeram montar a Salomão na mula do rei Davi, e o levaram a Giom.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ קֶ֤רֶן הַשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ מִן־ הָאֹ֔הֶל וַיִּמְשַׁ֖ח אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם יְחִ֖י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- qe·ren haš·še·men min- hā·’ō·hel way·yim·šaḥ ’eṯ- šə·lō·mōh way·yiṯ·qə·‘ū baš·šō·w·p̄ār way·yō·mə·rū kāl- hā·‘ām yə·ḥî ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon Then they blew the ram’s horn and all the people proclaimed Long live King Solomon
verses.literalPt: E Zadoque, o sacerdote, tomou o chifre de azeite do tabernáculo, e ungiu a Salomão; e tocaram a trombeta, e todo o povo disse: Viva o rei Salomão!

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ כָל־ הָעָם֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔יו וְהָעָם֙ מְחַלְּלִ֣ים בַּחֲלִלִ֔ים וּשְׂמֵחִ֖ים שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַתִּבָּקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּקוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū ḵāl hā·‘ām ’a·ḥă·rāw wə·hā·‘ām mə·ḥal·lə·lîm ba·ḥă·li·lîm ū·śə·mê·ḥîm śim·ḥāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh wat·tib·bā·qa‘ hā·’ā·reṣ bə·qō·w·lām
verses.literal: All the people . . . . . . followed him playing flutes and rejoicing with such a great joy that the earth was split by the sound
verses.literalPt: E todo o povo subiu após ele, e o povo tocava gaitas, e alegrava-se com grande alegria; de maneira que com o seu clamor a terra retiniu.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֲדֹנִיָּ֗הוּ וְכָל־ הַקְּרֻאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וְהֵ֖ם כִּלּ֣וּ לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יוֹאָב֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַדּ֥וּעַ קֽוֹל־ הַקִּרְיָ֖ה הוֹמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū wə·ḵāl haq·qə·ru·’îm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw wə·hêm kil·lū le·’ĕ·ḵōl way·yiš·ma‘ yō·w·’āḇ ’eṯ- qō·wl haš·šō·w·p̄ār way·yō·mer mad·dū·a‘ qō·wl- haq·qir·yāh hō·w·māh
verses.literal: Now Adonijah and all his guests - were finishing their feast . . . when they heard the sound of the ram’s horn Why is the city in such a loud uproar asked Joab
verses.literalPt: E o ouviu Adonias, e todos os convidados que estavam com ele, que tinham acabado de comer; também Joabe ouviu o sonido das trombetas, e disse: Por que há tal ruído de cidade alvoroçada?

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהִנֵּ֧ה יוֹנָתָ֛ן בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בָּ֑א וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲדֹנִיָּ֙הוּ֙ בֹּ֔א כִּ֣י אִ֥ישׁ חַ֛יִל אַ֖תָּה וְט֥וֹב תְּבַשֵּֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū mə·ḏab·bêr wə·hin·nêh yō·w·nā·ṯān ben- ’eḇ·yā·ṯār hak·kō·hên bā way·yō·mer ’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū bō kî ’îš ḥa·yil ’at·tāh wə·ṭō·wḇ tə·ḇaś·śêr
verses.literal: As he was speaking suddenly Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest arrived Come in said Adonijah for you are a man of valor You must be bringing good news
verses.literalPt: Estando ele ainda falando, eis que vem Jônatas, filho de Abiatar, o sacerdote, e disse Adonias: Entra, porque és homem valente, e trarás boas novas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַן֙ יוֹנָתָ֔ן וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לַאֲדֹנִיָּ֑הוּ אֲבָ֕ל אֲדֹנֵ֥ינוּ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ דָּוִ֖ד הִמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an yō·w·nā·ṯān way·yō·mer la·’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū ’ă·ḇāl ’ă·ḏō·nê·nū ham·me·leḵ- dā·wiḏ him·lîḵ ’eṯ- šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: Not at all Jonathan . . . replied Our lord King David has made Solomon king
verses.literalPt: E respondeu Jônatas, e disse a Adonias: Certamente nosso senhor, rei Davi, constituiu rei a Salomão;

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אִתּֽוֹ־ הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ אֶת־ צָד֨וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶת־ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֗יא וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְהַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וַיַּרְכִּ֣בוּ אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל פִּרְדַּ֥ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’it·tōw- ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên wə·’eṯ- nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·hak·kə·rê·ṯî wə·hap·pə·lê·ṯî way·yar·ki·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw ‘al pir·daṯ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: And with Solomon the king has sent Zadok the priest Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada along with the Cherethites and Pelethites and they have set him on the king’s mule
verses.literalPt: E o rei enviou com ele a Zadoque, o sacerdote, e a Natã, o profeta, e a Benaia, filho de Joiada, e aos quereteus e aos peleteus; e o fizeram montar na mula do rei.

verses.original: וַיִּמְשְׁח֣וּ אֹת֡וֹ צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֣ן וְנָתָן֩ הַנָּבִ֨יא לְמֶ֜לֶךְ בְּגִח֗וֹן וַיַּעֲל֤וּ מִשָּׁם֙ שְׂמֵחִ֔ים וַתֵּהֹ֖ם הַקִּרְיָ֑ה ה֥וּא הַקּ֖וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·šə·ḥū ’ō·ṯōw ṣā·ḏō·wq hak·kō·hên wə·nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî lə·me·leḵ bə·ḡi·ḥō·wn way·ya·‘ă·lū miš·šām śə·mê·ḥîm wat·tê·hōm haq·qir·yāh hū haq·qō·wl ’ă·šer šə·ma‘·tem
verses.literal: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon and they have gone up from there with rejoicing that rings out in the city That is the noise you hear
verses.literalPt: E Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Natã, o profeta, o ungiram rei em Giom, e dali subiram alegres, e a cidade está alvoroçada; este é o clamor que ouviste.

verses.original: וְגַם֙ יָשַׁ֣ב שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam yā·šaḇ šə·lō·mōh ‘al kis·sê ham·mə·lū·ḵāh
verses.literal: Moreover Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne
verses.literalPt: E também Salomão está assentado no trono do reino.

verses.original: וְגַם־ בָּ֜אוּ עַבְדֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לְ֠בָרֵךְ אֶת־ אֲדֹנֵ֜ינוּ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֮ לֵאמֹר֒ יֵיטֵ֨ב אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶת־ שֵׁ֤ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מִשְּׁמֶ֔ךָ וִֽיגַדֵּ֥ל אֶת־ כִּסְא֖וֹ מִכִּסְאֶ֑ךָ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- bā·’ū ‘aḇ·ḏê ham·me·leḵ lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nê·nū ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ lê·mōr yê·ṭêḇ ʾɛ̆·lō·hɛ·ḵå̄ ’eṯ- šêm šə·lō·mōh miš·šə·me·ḵā wî·ḡad·dêl ’eṯ- kis·’ōw mik·kis·’e·ḵā way·yiš·ta·ḥū ham·me·leḵ ‘al- ham·miš·kāḇ
verses.literal: The king’s servants have also gone to congratulate our lord King David saying May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than your own name and may He make his throne greater than your throne And the king has bowed in worship on his bed
verses.literalPt: E também os servos do rei vieram abençoar a nosso senhor, o rei Davi, dizendo: Faça teu Deus que o nome de Salomão seja melhor do que o teu nome; e faça que o seu trono seja maior do que o teu trono. E o rei se inclinou no leito.

verses.original: וְגַם־ כָּ֖כָה אָמַ֣ר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בָּר֨וּךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֥ן הַיּ֛וֹם יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְאִ֖י וְעֵינַ֥י רֹאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- kā·ḵāh ’ā·mar ham·me·leḵ bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer nā·ṯan hay·yō·wm yō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·’î wə·‘ê·nay rō·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: saying Blessed be the LORD the God of Israel Today He has provided one to sit on my throne and my eyes have seen it
verses.literalPt: E também disse o rei assim: Bendito o SENHOR Deus de Israel, que hoje tem dado quem se assente no meu trono, e que os meus olhos o vissem.

verses.original: וַיֶּֽחֶרְדוּ֙ וַיָּקֻ֔מוּ כָּל־ הַ֨קְּרֻאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַאֲדֹנִיָּ֑הוּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥer·ḏū way·yā·qu·mū kāl- haq·qə·ru·’îm ’ă·šer la·’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū way·yê·lə·ḵū ’îš lə·ḏar·kōw
verses.literal: At this, all the guests of Adonijah arose in terror and scattered . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Então estremeceram e se levantaram todos os convidados que estavam com Adonias; e cada um se foi ao seu caminho.

verses.original: וַאֲדֹ֣נִיָּ֔הוּ יָרֵ֖א מִפְּנֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיָּ֣קָם וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ וַֽיַּחֲזֵ֖ק בְּקַרְנ֥וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū yā·rê mip·pə·nê šə·lō·mōh way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ way·ya·ḥă·zêq bə·qar·nō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: But Adonijah in fear of Solomon got up and went to take hold of the horns of the altar
verses.literalPt: Porém Adonias temeu a Salomão; e levantou-se, e foi, e apegou-se às pontas do altar.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֤ד לִשְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּה֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיָּ֔הוּ יָרֵ֖א אֶת־ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְ֠הִנֵּה אָחַ֞ז בְּקַרְנ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יִשָּֽׁבַֽע־ לִ֤י כַיּוֹם֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אִם־ יָמִ֥ית אֶת־ עַבְדּ֖וֹ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ liš·lō·mōh lê·mōr hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nî·yā·hū yā·rê ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh wə·hin·nêh ’ā·ḥaz bə·qar·nō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ lê·mōr yiš·šā·ḇa‘- lî ḵay·yō·wm ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh ’im- yā·mîṯ ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·dōw be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: It was reported to Solomon Behold Adonijah fears King Solomon . . . and he has taken hold of the horns of the altar saying Let King Solomon first swear to me not to put his servant to the sword
verses.literalPt: E fez-se saber a Salomão, dizendo: Eis que Adonias teme ao rei Salomão; porque eis que apegou-se às pontas do altar, dizendo: Jure-me hoje o rei Salomão que não matará o seu servo à espada.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אִ֚ם יִהְיֶ֣ה לְבֶן־ חַ֔יִל לֹֽא־ יִפֹּ֥ל מִשַּׂעֲרָת֖וֹ אָ֑רְצָה וְאִם־ רָעָ֥ה תִמָּצֵא־ ב֖וֹ וָמֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·lō·mōh ’im yih·yeh lə·ḇen- ḥa·yil lō- yip·pōl miś·śa·‘ă·rā·ṯōw ’ā·rə·ṣāh wə·’im- rā·‘āh ṯim·mā·ṣê- ḇōw wā·mêṯ
verses.literal: And Solomon replied If he is a man of character not a single hair of his will fall to the ground But if evil is found in him he will die
verses.literalPt: E disse Salomão: Se for homem de bem, nem um de seus cabelos cairá em terra; se, porém, se achar nele maldade, morrerá.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וַיֹּרִדֻ֙הוּ֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיָּבֹ֕א וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ ל֥וֹ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לֵ֥ךְ לְבֵיתֶֽךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh way·yō·ri·ḏu·hū mê·‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·yā·ḇō way·yiš·ta·ḥū lam·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh way·yō·mer- lōw šə·lō·mōh lêḵ lə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: So King Solomon summoned Adonijah down from the altar and he came and bowed down before King Solomon who said to him Go to your home
verses.literalPt: E mandou o rei Salomão, e o fizeram descer do altar; e veio, e prostrou-se perante o rei Salomão, e Salomão lhe disse: Vai para tua casa.
